ticker_news.title: Where Will Palantir Stock Be in 3 Years?
ticker_news.description: Palantir Technologies (PLTR) has seen its stock price surge 48% so far this year, outperforming the broader market. While the company's financial performance has been strong, the author argues that Palantir's valuation has become disconnected from reality and may be overvalued.
ticker_news.author: Adam Spatacco

SPY.title: Explosion Rocks Chernobyl Nuclear Site As Zelenskyy Signals Readiness For Peace Talks
SPY.description: A drone attack on the Chernobyl nuclear site has raised concerns about the ongoing war in Ukraine, even as President Zelenskyy signals readiness for peace talks with Russia.
SPY.author: Erica Kollmann
